title: Timed (3 min): parallel-filter count
prompt:
Set a real timer for **3 minutes**. Implement `countBelow`: count the values `vals[i]` **strictly below** limit where the parallel `flags[i]` equals "on".

After submitting, log: target vs actual, and which phase ate the surplus.

tests.name: parallel count
tests.hint: One loop, two conditions (flag equals, value below); empty arrays return 0.
